research.source_policy: Completed UTC 1H/4H OHLCV aggregated from checksum-validated 1m futures archives; retain native higher-timeframe archives and every discrepancy; not resampled indicators
research.execution: Next eligible 1m open at/after modeled publication availability; stops remain active; ambiguous intrabar stop/target is stop-first; gap stops fill adversely; full taker exits
research.trend_exit: Completed 1h close <= EMA50 for long, >= EMA50 for short; next eligible modeled open
research.partition_boundary: Start flat; force remaining positions flat at last minute close; no trades cross partitions; preserve original indicator seeds
research.sizing: Independent equal-capital sleeves; entry notional plus fee capped to positive current sleeve cash equity; fractional research quantity; no leveraged liquidation model
research.funding: Actual timestamp/rate/associated mark price; positive funding debits longs and credits shorts; absent coverage blocks replay
research.historical_filters: Dated current price-filter snapshot applied across history; historical filter changes not reconstructed
research.uncertainty: Deterministic 3-calendar-month moving-block bootstrap, 2000 replications; small partition samples disclosed
research.status: Preregistered local research specification; no parameters selected from results

report.assessment: Research only. No parameters selected from results; historical holdout is procedural, not a forward unseen market sample.
limitations: 1m OHLC cannot identify intrabar order; stop-first ties and approximate exit times are disclosed.
Spread, slippage and publication latency are modeled; historical order-book liquidity/fills are unavailable.
Dated current price-filter snapshot applied across history; historical filter changes not reconstructed
Monthly archives may be corrected later; this run pins their downloaded SHA-256.
Native higher-timeframe archives disagree with raw-minute aggregation in recorded periods; canonical overrides are explicit, not proof of tick-level truth.
Dated current price-filter snapshot applied across history; historical filter changes not reconstructed
Fractional research quantities; historical quantity/notional filters and liquidation are not simulated.
Funding within a minute precedes its unknown intrabar exit; exact settlement/exit ordering may differ.
Partition boundaries force flat positions; results are separate experiments, not one continuously compounded account.
Equity/drawdown use hourly contract-price marks after paid costs, without hypothetical liquidation fees on open positions.
MAE/MFE omit exit-minute unknown extremes; observations are censored, not exact tick excursions.
No parameter/strategy search, walk-forward refitting, regime classification or SMA benchmark has been performed.
Two chosen survivors do not represent Binance's historical universe; no survivorship-free universe claim.
Bootstrap intervals have only 6 or 12 calendar months per partition and are exploratory.
No forward paper performance or production reliability claim.
